ns2:course.label: Advanced Scene Design, I
ns2:course.description: (THEAT 325) Advanced problems in scene design for non-proscenium theatres (Section A) and television, film, and industrial design (Section B). Enrollment limited to Theatre majors. 4 undergraduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours if topics vary. Cannot repeat a section already taken. Prerequisite: THEA 226 or consent of instructor.
